name: @cori-do/runner
description: Deno-based runner that hosts Cori `code` activities in a sandboxed subprocess.

scripts.build: deno check --config deno.json --lock deno.lock --frozen runner.ts schema.ts
scripts.lint: deno fmt --check runner.ts schema.ts schema.test.ts runner.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: deno check --config deno.json --lock deno.lock --frozen runner.ts schema.ts runner.test.ts
scripts.test: deno test --config deno.json --lock deno.lock --frozen --allow-read --allow-write --allow-run schema.test.ts runner.test.ts
